with the surgery for just over a year now...nothing but problems!
Have been without my contraceptive pill for at least a couple of weeks now as my 1st 2 requests were ignored, 3rd request I got an automated response that I should go to pharmacy 1st (even though I've stated more than once I have the pill for endometriosis...which I am now doubled over in pain from), finally on 4th request Dr Baker himself issued it.
Registered my 2 daughters and partner online a few weeks ago... Hear nothing so ask how much longer and get told "I am not seeing any requests for either of your Daughters. You will need to come into the surgery to pick up a form to complete you can do this at anytime, however when you return the forms you will need to bring them back between 9-11 or 2 - 4", I provide screenshots of the emails with the registration codes on, then get told "Even if we had received the on line registration you would still need to come into the surgery for the additional questionnaire forms", when asked what I should do because I work full time I get told "Unfortunately these are the only times that we can accept them, so if anyone is unable to make the times they would need to look to register at another surgery."
I work at a doctor's surgery myself as a care coordinator/medical receptionist, and under no circumstances would we ever talk and treat patients the way I have been spoken to, I would lose my job if I'd responded in such a way and left a patient without their medication. The only reason I went to this surgery was because of Dr Van Biljon who is absolutely amazing and truly listens to you.
I am absolutely appalled and absolutely will be "looking to register at another surgery" with my family.",null,[0,227]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pONlRXTmphVkZRY2pCWVRWQjVNMEY0ZDNaNVMyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x4f991bf8b999b25d!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjN6TWNjaVFQcjBYTVB5M0F4d3Z5S2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pONlRXTmphVkZRY2pCWVRWQjVNMEY0ZDNaNVMyYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi1yZiVrrOTAxWVJWMBHdZ-L8kQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi1yZiVrrOTAxWVJWMBHdZ-L8kQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMWQ0T1dORmVWOWZSV2hFTm5wbVowVjJObEZ4YjFsWE9EWktiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpWV1VOYVlrZ3hkMVJKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SNWMwWmZjbEppTVRsTlpqZzNaVEZ3Y3pZelZtYxAB",["0x0:0x4f991bf8b999b25d",null,1761925236414958,1761925236414958,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/101212321571072319005/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Melanie Roberts","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLPTwd-yQ6qet48AL9MgA1GZYW-q09KLbaezcanPQAAaUsX3g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/101212321571072319005?hl=en"],"101212321571072319005",null,4,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["4 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi1yZiVrrOTAxWVJWMBHdZ-L8kQ7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"4 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Atrocious!
